system.description: A style of mental speed and perception that wins the fight in the mind first, using fencing blades.
system.summary: A style of mental speed and perception that wins the fight in the mind first, using fencing blades.

entries.name: Weapon (Fencing)
entries.effect: Special Attack must be made with a Fencing weapon.

entries.name: Action (Feint)
entries.effect: Special Attacks may use Feint; attack advantages apply to the ordinary attack made after the feint, which cannot itself be a Special Attack.

entries.name: Backhanded Blade
entries.effect: The attack can never inflict Critical Damage.

entries.name: Dipping Swallow
entries.effect: One extra reaction, only for Parry, lasting to your coming turn.

entries.name: Skill (Scrutiny)
entries.effect: Roll Scrutiny against the target's Static Defense as part of the attack; failure means the attack fails.

entries.name: Flurry of Blows
entries.effect: Each purchase adds one more weapon attack to this attack.

entries.name: Mastery (Open Form Motion)
entries.effect: After a successful feint you may follow with any attack type, not only a Standard Attack.

entries.name: Weakening Grip Technique
entries.effect: A target hit tests Dexterity at TN 20; on a failure it lets go of what it holds.

entries.name: Essence Draining Strike
entries.effect: A target hit loses 5 resource points.
